title: TRINX Collection 2024: GTR C6
notes: Manufacturer regional catalog identifies the exact green/brown GTR C6 with LTWOO ST/RD-GR7010 1x12, 11-46T cassette, 42T crank, LTWOO hydraulic discs, double-wall 700C wheels and CST 700x40C stock tires. The frame row omits its material, and international GTR C6 builds vary, so China-market carbon construction is sourced separately and the 40C stock tire is not inferred to be the maximum.
